messages:
sam: Quick design review 1— experimenting with an inline 'create key' row instead of a modal. Also proposing a soft-revoke inline banner in the empty state (undoable) so users stay in context. Mock: https://staging.redwood.local/mock/creds-inline-v1.png

maria: Inline create feels faster. Concern: will admins miss scope details? Maybe add a lightweight 'about scopes' link next to the CTA. :thinking_face: 

lee: Implementation note: fine to inline, but do NOT sync-fetch org scopes on mount. Lazy-load when the scope picker opens. Also ensure keyboard focus order when the row expands.

ada: A11y: scope picker must be a combobox (aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant). Soft-revoke banner should announce with aria-live="polite"; when revoke completes use role="status" + aria-live="assertive" to say "Key revoked. Undo". Provide clear aria-labels on undo/delete buttons.

sam: For revoke UX, instead of a blocking modal I want revoke -> collapse row to a yellow banner with "Undo" and "Delete permanently". Keeps context. Would prefer microcopy variant A: "Key revoked 1— Undo" over B: "Revoked 1— remove permanently".

maria: +1 on A. Also add helper text under create CTA: "Keys are scoped to roles. Admins can rotate or restrict later." That should lower accidental broad perms.

lee: Backend contract: make revoke idempotent and support optimistic UI. Row should show "Revoking..." while job runs; on failure revert with inline error and suggestion to retry.

ada: Accessibility checklist items for acceptance: combobox keyboard nav, focus trap avoidance on expand, aria-live policies for banners, visible focus ring on inline status pills, 4.5:1 contrast for pill colors. I'll post snippets in the spec.

sam: Action items: (1) I'll update mock + Loom keyboard demo. (2) @lee define lazy-load and revoke states in API spec. (3) @ada add a11y acceptance criteria. (4) @maria finalize microcopy.

deploy-bot: sam opened branch feat/creds-inline 1— CI green, preview: https://staging.redwood.local/creds-inline-2189991234

maria: I'll draft the short UX spec and propose an A/B test (compact inline vs modal) for 5% of new orgs.

sam: Thanks all 1— will follow up after mocks are updated and share the aria snippets.
